change_summary: Shadow-evaluated a liquidity-filtered earnings-adjacent universe using archived earnings snapshots and fixed OHLCV snapshots without changing production universe or strategy code.
hypothesis: A liquidity-filtered earnings-adjacent shadow universe may surface event-sensitive candidates with lower A/B overlap and better forward-return quality than the rejected volatility-expansion shadow universe, without changing production universe or strategy logic.
notes: Artifact: data/exp_20260426_031_universe_scout_earnings_adjacent.json. Primary window only had earnings snapshot coverage: 129 snapshot days, 528 candidates, 38 tickers, same-day A/B overlap 0.38%, ticker-history overlap 79.36%, outside-production candidates 0. Earnings fields were fully present for candidate rows, but 5d avg forward return was -0.91% and 10d avg was -2.47% with 39.15% win rate. Mid/old windows had zero earnings snapshots, so this source is observed-only and not promotion-ready.
